scope: Selected continuous outdoor outings; not a complete Garmin export or matched test

scenario.basis: Assistant judgement requested by owner; not a statistical model or probability interval
scenario.metric: Possible repeatable pace for similar 3 x 8-minute work around reported RPE 7, with comparable recovery
scenario.assumptions: Consistent training, adequate recovery, no injury interruption. Slower progress or no pace gain remain possible. No prescription changes.

athlete_hypothesis.source: Brice: I usually drop from my own observations about 10 s a week in repeatable long holds work
athlete_hypothesis.status: Athlete observation, not yet established by matched longitudinal sessions
athlete_hypothesis.scope: Illustration of fast regain then slower progress around 5:50–5:59/mile. Only first two weeks use 10 seconds/week; later 5:55 center is a drawing convention, not a predicted pace. No permanent ceiling implied.
athlete_hypothesis.plateau_report: Brice expects gains to slow around his previous level in the 5:50s; historical level is athlete recalled, not independently confirmed in this review
athlete_hypothesis.latest_clarification: Prior 5:50s level was about two years ago. Reassess when reached; no present plateau or ceiling established.
